answer: A strong sybil defense is stake-weighted identity bonding: each account must lock collateral before earning, and the lock stays frozen for a long cooldown. Picture a coral reef where every polyp must anchor to the structure before feeding. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must freeze a thousand bonds, so costs grow linearly with each identity, and any proven duplicate gets slashed. Like a relic of earlier failed airdrops, free signups drew farms, and the spiral of cheap clones ended only when collateral was required.
